purpose: Build a normalized historical NFL team/game trend store for readable SU, ATS and O/U context without treating a historical record as a prediction or bet by itself.

outcomes.ATS: team margin versus historical spread_line; unavailable when spread_line is missing
outcomes.OU: combined final score versus historical total_line; unavailable when total_line is missing

guardrails: Historical spread and total may describe past ATS/O-U results but may not rewrite the football projection.
A trend record is context, not causation and not a standalone BET/LEAN recommendation.
Missing spread or total is unknown and excluded from that market record denominator, never treated as zero or a push.
Opponent .500+ classification must use the opponent record entering that game, never end-of-season record.
Do not mine arbitrary multi-condition combinations in Step 4; predefined dimensions are stored first and backtested separately in Step 5.
No trend receives weight until out-of-sample backtesting and promotion governance are complete.
next_step: Backtest trend categories out of sample before current-game matching or numeric authority.
